name: Armchair
dimensions: Height 99 cm; Height 46.5 cm; Length 57.5 cm
summary: This elaborately carved and red lacquered armchair has a removable back and arms, possibly for ease of packing and shipment to the West. Furniture of this kind aimed at foreign markets was produced in Shanghai and Ningbo. Pieces often incorporated carved panels of intricate figurative and landscape
